# US Scene Buy — llms.txt
# GEO helper: concise map for answer engines / assistants.
# Site: scene decision help + Amazon Associate links. Not medical/plumbing certification.

> https://van0710-source.github.io/us-scene-buy/

## Primary
- [Home](https://van0710-source.github.io/us-scene-buy/): Match one next step for clogged, slow, or smelly kitchen sinks; buying nothing is allowed.
- [Decision quiz](https://van0710-source.github.io/us-scene-buy/quiz.html): ≤5 questions → one primary pick (physical / enzyme / gel / call pro / wait) with Amazon check-price links.
- [Guides by symptom](https://van0710-source.github.io/us-scene-buy/guides/): Urgent, slow/smelly, and compatibility paths.
- [How recommendations are made](https://van0710-source.github.io/us-scene-buy/about.html): Constraints, evidence labels, and no-buy boundaries.

## Conversion probes (other scenes)
- [Air purifier by room size](https://van0710-source.github.io/us-scene-buy/guides/air-purifier-room-size.html): CADR / coverage match; not medical advice.
- [Hard floor cleaner pick](https://van0710-source.github.io/us-scene-buy/guides/hard-floor-cleaner-pick.html): tile / LVP / hardwood constraint → cleaner or wet vac.

## Rules we state on-site
- Never mix drain chemicals; follow the product label.
- Do not promise guaranteed clear times or “never clogs again.”
- Guides show a primary pick + Amazon “Check price” CTA; quiz is optional refine.
- Affiliate disclosure: Amazon Associates; prices/stock change at checkout.
